searchText: I wanted to raise this proposal from Vitalik about STARK-based transaction pool management. I think this could be leveraged by stateless clients to maintain a tx pool for FOCIL IL proposers. https://ethresear.ch/t/recursive-stark-based-bandwidth-efficient-mempool/23838
